# London Handstand Academy

> Handstand coaching in London and online, run by Elliott Staley. In person at OverGravity, Shadwell (East London), or fully online from anywhere. Beginners to advanced: from a first kick up to freestanding holds and the press.

## Who
- Elliott Staley, founder and head coach (Instagram @elliottstaley). Nearly a decade of personal handstand practice, blending yoga, calisthenics and movement coaching. Coaches all private 1-1 sessions.
- Suryava (@flying_with_strength), gymnastics and calisthenics coach, over eight years training and coaching gymnastics. Co-runs the workshops.
- Beth Shum (@flexibility_matters), chartered physiotherapist.

## Ways to train (prices in GBP, September 2026)
- Free app, the Handstand Ladder: a short quiz places you on one of six stages (Foundations, Wall Work, Pushing More, Take-Off, Freestanding, Press) and builds a workout at your level, with a filmed demo and cues for every drill. Foundations is free, no account needed.
- The full ladder in the app: every stage plus fixes (four week plans for one specific problem), £10 a month, 7 days free to start.
- Form check: film one attempt and Elliott replies on video within 48 hours with the one thing to change. The first is free with an account, then £20 a clip.
- Online coaching: your own programme in the app, rewritten every six weeks, video form checks every two weeks, questions answered within 48 hours, and the full ladder (every stage and fix) included. £120 a month, month to month, no joining fee.
- Online coaching with a 60 minute session in London each month: £190 a month.
- Inner Circle: online coaching with a weekly check in and the plan adjusted weekly. Three places, by application. £250 a month, £320 with the London session.
- One-off 1-1 session in London: £80 for 60 minutes, £100 for 90 minutes, credited to a first month of coaching if joining within 14 days.
- Workshops: small group handstand classes at OverGravity, Shadwell, usually monthly.
- A free 15 minute call to talk through which fits.
